My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I recently completed my M.S. in Computer Engineering at RIT (May 2026) and came across your posting for the 2026 Early Career Embedded Software Engineer role, along with three other embedded openings on TP-Link's Workable page (IDs: 0DC81C1556, E78A84552E, F943A617EC).

My background covers embedded C/C++, edge AI deployment on Jetson with TensorRT, and bare-metal STM32 firmware - which maps well to the roles. Before applying, I wanted to ask directly: I am on F-1 OPT, which provides US work authorization without employer action during the OPT period. Are any of these openings compatible with that status?

Happy to share my resume if my profile looks like a fit.
draft.sign_off:
Thank you,
Justin Mascarenhas
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/justinmascarenhas
